title: fix(plugin-chatbot): the build result card draws the checklist verification line and states a failed build once
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBNgJrQDxaUNx2so1ektgf6A)_

Fixes #34627

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 搭建结果卡的核对清单现在会显示云端新增的 `verification` 行（红色，显示云端给的标签和问题数）；清单失败时，搭建的草稿卡不再显示「N 处待修复」标签和红色的「fix the problems」提示，失败只在清单里说一次。清单里其它新种类的行（如之后的 `publish`）按其 `status` 和 `line` 原样显示，不必再改控制台。
- 为什么改：#34627（cloud#4799 的控制台一半）。以前控制台丢掉这一行，失败的搭建显示「核对通过 4/5」却只列 4 行，同一屏还重复说了两次失败。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` 的映射和结果卡渲染，没有新的语言键，不动契约和服务端；已有三种行的显示与原来一致。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/mapMessages.ts` 的 `checklistLineOf`（哪些行保留、哪些丢弃）；`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` 的 `BuildChecklistRows`（红色行）和 `renderToolDetail` 的 `failureOnChecklist`（什么时候不画标签和红字）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.checklistVerification-34627.test.tsx`，预期 9 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Mapper** (`mapMessages.ts`). `BuildResultChecklist.lines` is now a union, `BuildResultChecklistLine`. `detectBuildChecklist` reads each line through `checklistLineOf`:
  - `object` / `view` / `sampleData`: read as before (`status` + `line`).
  - `verification` (cloud `ChecklistVerificationLine`, `{ kind: 'verification', status: 'failed', label, count }`): kept only when `status` is `failed`, `label` is a non-empty string and `count` is a non-negative integer. Anything else under this kind is dropped; it is not read as a generic line.
  - Any other kind with a valid `status` and a non-empty string `line` is kept as `{ kind: 'other', servedKind, status, line }` (the claim's last paragraph, from cloud note 6941198748: cloud#4809's `publish` line is the next such kind).
- **Result card** (`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, `BuildChecklistRows`). A `verification` row is drawn in red (`XCircle`, `text-red-600 dark:text-red-400`, `data-kind="verification"`). It shows the producer's `label`, then the count through the existing `chatbot.build.issuesCount` key (zh `3 处待修复`, en `3 to fix`). No new locale key, and no copy of the producer's wording. An `other` row is drawn like the existing rows, by `status` and `line`. Rows of the existing kinds keep their markup unchanged. The chip still reads the served `passed/total`.
- **One statement of failure.** When the turn's result card shows a checklist whose `status` is `failed`, `renderToolDetail` gets `failureOnChecklist`. The build's draft card then draws neither its error-count chip (`draft-verification-chip`, "N to fix") nor the red `draft-issues-summary` ("fix the problems"). The findings stay behind its closed Technical details disclosure. A clean "Verified" chip and the amber warnings-only summary are not failure statements, so they draw as before.
- Patch changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`. `detectBuildChecklist` and its types are not exported from the package index, so no public type changes.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.checklistVerification-34627.test.tsx` (9 tests). Every message goes through the real `uiMessageToChatMessage`:

- Mapper: a verification line is kept with label and count; malformed verification lines are dropped (empty label, `count: -1`, `count: '3'`, `status: 'passed'`, a `line` instead of `label`/`count`); a `publish` line is kept by `status` + `line`, and malformed ones are dropped. CONTROL: a checklist without the new line maps exactly as before.
- Card: a failed build reads `核对通过 4/5` over 5 rows. Exactly one row is failed, and it reads `校验未通过 · 3 处待修复` in red. The draft card has no `draft-verification-chip` and no `draft-issues-summary`, and Technical details is still there. A new kind renders by its line. CONTROL: a passed checklist without the new line draws 7/7 over 7 rows with no `data-kind`, and the draft card keeps its chip and summary. CONTROL: no checklist (an older producer) keeps the chip and summary.

<details><summary>Readings at head 61db196c</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-chatbot/` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0): `Test Files 102 passed (102)`, `Tests 1038 passed (1038)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the three touched files: exit 0, 0 errors (12 warnings, all `react-hooks` warnings outside this diff's hunks).
- Ablation A: `checklistLineOf`'s `if (r.kind === 'verification') {` was replaced through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `4268370a3031` to `7f5534781a7a`). The new file went red: `3 failed | 6 passed (9)`. The mapper keep test, the malformed-drop test and the 4/5 card test failed. Restored: blob equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Ablation B: the call site's `{ failureOnChecklist: buildChecklist?.status === 'failed' }` was replaced with `{ failureOnChecklist: false }` (blob `af2d03d4e901` to `d75c90814fb0`). Result: `1 failed | 8 passed (9)`, and the failed test is the draft-card test. Restored: blob equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Gate families (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`): `39 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 39 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`. This includes `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (`Tests 5077 passed | 2 skipped`). `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=claude/issue-34627-checklist-verification-line`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` against origin/main 7752cac7.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The vendored producer schema (`__tests__/fixtures/build-cards.schema.ts`, copied at cloud f0ecef3a) predates `ChecklistVerificationLine`. This session cannot read the cloud repository, so the copy was not refreshed. The new fixtures follow the shape the card and the claim name, and they are not routed through `buildCards.contract-12724.test.ts`. Refreshing the vendored copy at a cloud sha that carries the line would let the contract test check them.
- Branch base is origin/main 0ad377c1. origin/main has since moved to 7752cac7. The one incoming plugin-chatbot commit touches `toolResultParsers.ts`, which this diff does not touch. Overlap-check reports a clean merge, and CI runs on the merge ref.

## Verification

Run the new test file (command in 维护者速读). In a running console, a failed AI build's result card should read "Checks passed 4/5" over five rows, with one red row naming the issue count. The draft card under it should show no "N to fix" chip and no red "fix the problems" sentence.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. No `packages/spec` change.
- [x] 2. New names follow the casing for their kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran. eslint on the touched files is clean of errors; repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. Patch changeset with both declaration lines, here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The 维护者速读 block is the seat's maintainer summary.)
